title: Chapter 874

218. When one falls, a stronger one comes (3)
Southern Delki, a region where rifts occur.
"Ah, this is cheating!"
"Just when Lady Mary took down the leader, a new massive rift appears! These devilish creatures! They're making war so convenient? How can they start such a large-scale attack so easily?"
The Tona brothers shouted out.
Until just a moment ago, while Mary was dealing with a demon of leader class, the two men and their clan's knights were responsible for the rest of the demon world's troops.
Mary, covered in blood, was panting heavily.
Most of it was the purple blood of the just-killed demon, but there was also a bit of her own red blood mixed in.
"Sister, are you alright?"
"Yeah, I'm not dying yet. Damn it, if only the previous guy hadn't used a dirty trick at the end, I could've taken on another one. That bastard suddenly self-destructed?"
"Don't brag, you were just about to fall. We were worried you might actually die."

"That's right. He did introduce himself as someone quite known in the demon world, so there's no need for you to brag. What was it, a 30th generation noble? It seems he was the general of a clan belonging to something like that. Anyway, you fought well, sister."

"Shut up, let's just hold on until the reinforcements arrive. The one who will come out from that rift in the next minute is definitely much stronger than the one I just defeated. The energy I'm sensing is of a different dimension...."
Mary, the Tona brothers, and the knights were all tensed up and elevating their senses.
The intense battle they had just fought had already left them all completely drained.
If the reinforcements don't arrive quickly, the knights, if not the generations, could see a large number of casualties.
Mary was clenching her teeth around her venom sac, her eyes wide open.
The Tona brothers formed a sword line with the knights, centered around her.
Soon, a purple demonic energy exploded from the massive rift, creating a shockwave.
The explosion occurred about ten times in succession, breaking the knights' sword shield.
A demon emerged from the rift.
He had twin swords at his waist, and despite his eyes being covered by long hair, his aura was overflowing.
As soon as he took a step, large buildings and structures suddenly shot up all around the battlefield.
It was a fortress of the demon world summoned through the massive rift.
The knights had no choice but to break formation as they dodged the twisting shockwave of the ground.
"Ha, so Sykell is dead, huh?"
The demon stared at Mary, who had regained her footing, and spoke.
Before Mary and the knights could answer, they first looked around.
Naturally, the summoned fortress was full of demon forces, and they had already perfectly encircled the knights.
"Yeah, the entrance is disgustingly loud, demon. Yes, I killed him."
"What is your name, human?"
"I'm Mary Runcandel, the 7th generation of the Runcandel."
"Ah, Runcandel... the finest sword family in Inse. I am Fleck Caluga, the general of Caluga. The Sycle you killed was my confidant."
"Is that so?"
"Even if I kill you a thousand times, this emptiness will not go away. But since I can only kill you once, I'll make sure to end it as painfully as possible."
Just as Fleck was about to draw his twin swords,
[Vooooom!]
Suddenly, a white dimensional gate opened above the battlefield and an eyeball named Mort let out a cheerful cry.
Thud-!
There were three people on the Mort that landed on the ground.
Syris, along with Luna and Luntia.
Upon seeing them, the knights sighed with relief.
Of course, they didn't show any signs of being disheveled and immediately raised their swords in salute.
"Sis!"
"Oh, my sisters!"
"Glad we didn't arrive too late."
"Mary got a bit hurt, didn't she?"
"What? Really!? Who's the son of a bitch that did this to our Mary!"
"I personally killed the one who did it. So, I was a bit tired and was trying to rest, and now this newly arrived demon wants to kill me?"
Luna and Luntia turned their heads simultaneously to glare at Fleck.
"I am Luna Runcandel. Are you the one who threatened my sister?"
"You're lucky. If you had even touched a hair of Mary's, I would have killed you painfully. But now, it seems I can simply cut you down."
"But, sis. Heytona and I were also there. We were almost hit too."
"1st and 3rd flagbearers. I need to go to another area immediately. Please disembark quickly."
"Ah, right. Sorry, Sovereign of Bows. We must go!"
"Thanks for moving quickly. We will take care of things here, if you need support elsewhere, please come back."
"Then, good luck."
[Boong. Voooo.]
Mort jumped back into the white dimensional gate and disappeared.
Luna and Luntia warmed up and raised their axe sword Krantel and three swords Sharle.
"What were we talking about? Anyway, the price for trying to harm our Mary is very high. None of the demons gathered here today will survive."
"Let the ones who try to flee live. If they can flee, that is......"
The Tona brothers once again said 'But, sisters, we.' But Luna and Luntia were too focused on Fleck and the demons to hear.
Feeling awkward, the Tona brothers laughed for no reason and cursed at Fleck together.
"Now that our sisters are here, you're finished!"
Fleck was momentarily speechless, but the two newly arrived riders were well-known figures in the demonic world.
"Luna Runcandel and Luntia Runcandel...among them, Luna, I heard you can use red sword energy. Show me if it's true."
"You seem to know a lot. Well, I might use it if necessary, but I think I can handle you without it......"
"Sis, you take care of him. I will annihilate the soldiers. And Mary, the Tona brothers."
"Oh, you finally mentioned our names."
"Retreat with the knights and rest. You need to recover quickly to fight again."
"Understood. Then, I'm counting on you. Oh, sis. And be careful with those guys. The one I killed seemed overwhelmed and suddenly self-destructed."
Fleck immediately released his sword energy towards Mary and the retreating knights.
The demon soldiers who were surrounding them also fired their swords and magic, and the installed cannons.
However, Fleck's sword energy was blocked by Krantel, and Luntia, who had jumped up, neutralized the soldiers' attacks by scattering her own sword energy in all directions.
"So, there are some who dare to look away from Luntia and me. No matter how dark it is in Inse, if you do that, there will be a disaster......"
Zzzz-!
Krantel and Fleck's twin swords collided.
In a single strike, the ground where Fleck was standing sagged, and Fleck, with his eyes wide open, pushed Luna away.
In the meantime, Luntia had penetrated the enemy lines and began to slaughter the demons.
Most of them disappeared entirely at the jab of her sword, without even leaving a dying scream.
Only the higher-ranking demons managed to cross swords a couple of times before losing their lives.
Kwaaang-!
Chuck-!
Krantel constantly battered Fleck's twin swords.
With every swing of Luna's sword, giant sword marks were left on the ground and the clouds.
Mary described Fleck as a stronger opponent compared to Sycle, but from Luna's perspective, he was just a slightly special enemy.
"How ludicrous it is for a demon to boast against my tired sister. If it wasn't for the continuous battle, you wouldn't have been able to pressure Mary like this."
Fleck didn't respond and was reminded of the moments of defeat he had experienced several times before he became a general.
Among them, the image of one person who had perfectly overwhelmed him was particularly overlapping with Luna.
Phaelito Belgasium, the number one swordsman of the demonic world.
'So Luna, the legend is true. After Phaelito and Laiset, have I ever been so overwhelmed?'
Fleck quickly came to a conclusion.
Escape.
There was no point in risking his life to fight when the outcome was already determined.
If he self-destructed like Sycle, he might be able to inflict some injuries, but a fatal wound was unlikely.
"Luna will soon recover and slaughter the demons as if nothing happened.
'I will postpone my match with White Whale until Zito gives me more power.'
Unfortunately for Fleck, Luna could see right through him. There was no sense of desperation in his sword, which he had often seen in the 'relative weaklings' with whom she had crossed swords.
He is clearly weaker than herself, but Fleck is one of the commanders of the demonic realm.
If he escapes today, Fleck will kill and torture countless humans in the future. Therefore, Luna chose not to let him go.
She would not allow him to open a portal to escape, or use a spatial leap.
"As you wish, I'll show you."
Sword Art, Red Moon.
Krantel turned red. At that moment, Fleck was trying to teleport, just as Luna had anticipated.
He was attempting to cast a dark realm spatial leap magic, using the demonic troops that Luntia was slaughtering as a sacrifice.
Fleck believed he could escape, even if Luna used the red sword aura.
He had such an experience when he faced Phaelito in the past.
'If it's true that she used red energy, then that human, Luna, along with Chiron Runcandel, is the most dangerous person to Lord Zito right now.'
However, Fleck did not know that Phaelito had said such a thing about Luna and the red sword aura.
Fleck does not know the true nature of the red sword aura, unlike Phaelito.
Therefore, he concluded that he could escape Luna, just as he had escaped from Phaelito.
A portal opened.
With just one step, Fleck could immediately enter the portal and travel to the fortress where Jin and Saki were confronting each other.
And Fleck thought he had taken that step.
And that was the last conscious moment of Fleck Kaluga, the Commander of the Demonic Realm.
Contrary to Fleck's perception, his body had been completely disassembled by the red sword aura and was dissipating into particles as soon as the portal opened.
"Hoo!"
Luna, sweating, looked at the place where Fleck and the portal, which had disappeared with him, had been.
'Due to the previous great crack, it's quite exhausting to use consecutively... I should limit the use for a while. I'm worried that the usage limit my father mentioned might decrease further.'
Luntia, who had been busy demolishing the demons and their castle, shrugged her shoulders and looked back at Luna.
In a moment, all the enemies disappeared because Fleck used them as sacrifices.
"Huh? Sister! Are you okay?"
"I overdid it a bit to not let him escape. Since this place is settled, let's contact our youngest sister again and ask about the situation in other areas. I need to return to Tikan and rest a bit."
